limitations: Replay11 JSON records the executable SHA-256 but not the app bundle path or Electron Framework hash; the matching executable identifies a preserved bundle copy, not by itself the exact path used during replay.

The Framework SHA-256 was measured on 2026-10-12. Its matching bundle mtime and current deep code-signature verification do not independently prove that these exact framework bytes were loaded during replay11.
No Chromium exact generated sandbox profile was captured, so this does not establish the runtime profile or root cause.
This was a read-only bundle inspection: no app launch, Ollama action, socket probe, or OS/network configuration change was performed.
